name: arcseal
description: ArcSeal: timelock-encrypted sealed voting on Arc (drand quicknet + tlock)

scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm contracts:fmt && pnpm sdk:check-abi && pnpm contracts:snapshot:check
scripts.contracts:test: pnpm --filter '@arcseal/sdk...' build && cd contracts && forge test -vvv
scripts.contracts:test:ci: pnpm --filter '@arcseal/sdk...' build && cd contracts && forge test
scripts.contracts:abi: cd contracts && forge build && cd .. && pnpm --filter @arcseal/sdk generate:abi
scripts.e2e:dry-run: pnpm contracts:build && pnpm --filter '@arcseal/sdk...' build && pnpm --filter @arcseal/scripts e2e:dry-run
